title: Structural Dynamics of the Bacillus subtilis MntR Transcription Factor Is Locked by Mn(2+) Binding.
authors: Jelic Matosevic, Zoe; Radman, Katarina; Loubser, Jolene; Crnolatac, Ivo; Piantanida, Ivo; Cukrowski, Ignacy; Asler, Ivana Lescic; Bertosa, Branimir
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟结合实验研究Mn(2+)结合如何锁定枯草杆菌MntR转录因子的结构动态并增强其DNA结合能力，虽聚焦金属调控而非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但MD方法及TF-DNA结合机制对课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: Manganese (II) ions are essential for a variety of bacterial cellular processes. The transcription factor MntR is a metallosensor that regulates Mn(2+) ion homeostasis in the bacterium Bacillus subtilis. Its DNA-binding affinity is increased by Mn(2+) ion binding, allowing it to act as a transcriptional repressor of manganese import systems. Although experimentally well-researched, the molecular mechanism that regulates this process is still a puzzle. Computational simulations supported by circular dichroism (CD), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and native gel electrophoresis (native-PAGE) experiments were employed to study MntR structural and dynamical properties in the presence and absence of Mn(2+) ions. The results of molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that Mn(2+) ion binding reduces the structural dynamics of the MntR protein and shifts the dynamic equilibrium towards the conformations adequate for DNA binding. Results of CD and DSC measurements support the computational results showing the change in helical content and stability of the MntR protein upon Mn(2+) ion binding. Further, MD simulations show that Mn(2+) binding induces polarization of the protein electrostatic potential, increasing the positive electrostatic potential of the DNA-binding helices in particular. In order to provide a deeper understanding of the changes in protein structure and dynamics due to Mn(2+) binding, a mutant in which Mn(2+) binding is mimicked by a cysteine bridge was constructed and also studied computationally and experimentally.
abstract_zh: 锰(II)离子对多种细菌细胞过程至关重要。转录因子MntR是一种金属传感器，调节枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）中Mn(2+)离子的稳态。其DNA结合亲和力因Mn(2+)离子结合而增强，使其能够作为锰输入系统的转录抑制因子。尽管实验研究已相当深入，但调控这一过程的分子机制仍是一个谜。本研究采用计算模拟，并辅以圆二色光谱（circular dichroism, CD）、差示扫描量热法（differential scanning calorimetry, DSC）和天然凝胶电泳（native-PAGE）实验，以研究MntR在有无Mn(2+)离子条件下的结构和动态特性。分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟结果显示，Mn(2+)离子结合降低了MntR蛋白的结构动态性，并将动态平衡转向适合DNA结合的构象。CD和DSC测量结果支持计算模拟结果，表明Mn(2+)离子结合后MntR蛋白的螺旋含量和稳定性发生变化。此外，MD模拟显示，Mn(2+)结合诱导蛋白质静电势极化，特别是增加了DNA结合螺旋的正静电势。为了更深入理解Mn(2+)结合引起的蛋白质结构和动态变化，构建了一个通过半胱氨酸桥模拟Mn(2+)结合的突变体，并进行了计算和实验研究。
